Use case: precise-object-edit. Create exactly ONE Khue animation frame.
Image 1: EDIT TARGET, approved Khue in the required direction. Keep camera, identity, head size, outfit, navy trousers, jade tie and brown reporter satchel.
Image 2: current pose diagram, authority for limb paths and overlap.
Image 3: eight-pose sequence, motion context ONLY, not a sheet to reproduce. Order 0..3 top, 4..7 bottom.
Output ONE full-body sprite at same registration on transparent 2:3 canvas. It will be sampled to 32x48. Preserve a 39px-tall native character. Hip around y32, foot baseline y45, head unchanged.
IMPORTANT LIMB VOLUME: thighs about FOUR logical pixels wide including outline; calves at least THREE; forearms THREE; hands approximately THREE by THREE or FOUR; shoes FOUR by THREE. Maintain this visible thickness throughout the motion, including foreshortened limbs. No one-pixel stick limbs, tiny hands, pin feet, leg thinning when bent. Match approved body scale; do not inflate head to compensate.
Walk transitions WIDE -> CLOSING -> NARROW PASSING -> OPENING -> WIDE opposite step, with the same thigh/calf lengths and masses. Arms counter-swing, move toward torso in passing and open again in contact. Follow the actual current guide instead of drawing every frame in the same spread stance.
Clothing and shading: stable ivory shirt and navy palette, clear block clusters. Use depth/occlusion to darken rear limbs by one shade, keeping front limbs readable. Do not change leg colors randomly. Preserve satchel on the anatomical right hip according to image 1. Preserve its strap. Hands remain skin-colored.
Hard opaque square pixel blocks, transparent margins. No glow, shadow, diagram, guide colors, labels, ground line, scenery, extra frames, soft painting, new costume or individual resizing. Keep torso/head position fixed; only pose-dependent arms/legs change.

DIRECTION: Face DOWN/towards camera exactly like image 1. Foot swing is mostly depth (screen y): front shoe lower/longer projection, rear shoe higher/shorter, without reducing shoe or calf thickness. Frame 0 anatomical left leg is on SCREEN RIGHT and extends forward; alternate on frame 4.
TARGET FRAME 0: Contact: maximum projected separation in movement direction, one front foot planted and the other behind; arms at their widest counter-swing.
